name: Cosmic Horror
description: Slow-build dread; vast, indifferent forces; small humans glimpsing the wrong truth. Lovecraftian without naming Lovecraft.
voice_instruct: Narrate with quiet, measured horror. Long pauses before reveals. Drop in volume on the most disturbing lines so the listener leans in. Never speed up.
script_prompt_addendum: Maintain dread through specificity, not gore. Show the wrong angle, the wrong color, the wrong number of limbs in a single concrete detail rather than a paragraph of description. The narrator must NOT fully understand what they're describing — leave a gap the listener fills. End the final scene on an unresolved chill, not a clean wrap.
